title: Jayashan Manodya
organisations: Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology
executive_summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate specializing in Artificial Intelligence, focused on developing intelligent technologies to solve real-world problems. He has experience in various AI projects, including personalized nutrition platforms, conversational shopping assistants, and document question-answering systems, utilizing modern software engineering practices and a range of technologies.

section_summaries.summary: Jayashan Manodya is an IT undergraduate with a specialization in Artificial Intelligence, aiming to become an AI Engineer. He is engaged in various AI technologies and projects, emphasizing hands-on experience and continuous skill improvement.
Currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) in IT specializing in Artificial Intelligence at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology, with a high GPA of 3.93/4.0.
Jayashan has developed multiple AI-powered projects, including NutriLens AI, KIKO, IKMS, PlateX, WeatherLK, and TeaPlanter, showcasing his skills in various technologies and applications.
He is currently a part-time Creative Designer at Glanz Digital, contributing to digital marketing and branding efforts.
Jayashan possesses a diverse skill set in programming languages, frameworks, AI/ML tools, databases, and deployment technologies.
He has completed several certifications related to AI, programming, web development, and digital marketing.
Jayashan has been recognized for his academic excellence and participation in competitions, including being a Dean's List recipient and a finalist in an IoT project showcase.

important_facts: Jayashan Manodya has a GPA of 3.93/4.0 in his most recent semester at the Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology.
He is currently developing an AI-powered nutrition assistant under the Ascentic AI Launch Pad mentorship program.
